title: Splende
notes: Orchestral ballads and melodic pop-rock dominate; occasional electronic textures support bigger vocal arrangements.

title: Se avessi un cuore
notes: Synths and programmed beats anchor dance-led songwriting; one orchestral ballad remains an exception.

title: Bye Bye
notes: Canova-led electronic pop spans reggaeton-tinged grooves, EDM, trap accents and reflective ballads.
